{"definition":{"combatSystem":"spell","id":"wood-spell","programmaticDefinitionId":"object.weapon.wood-spell","arsenal":{"previewAssetGuid":"1401e5ef-a208-5834-9d7d-2b4a0ac28738","lineageId":"lineage.spell.five-elements","titleLine":"青木法诀","glyph":"木","drawWeight":1,"inventorySize":{"width":2,"height":2},"combatTags":["木","缠绕","草甸"]},"name":"青木术法","family":"elemental-spell","visualKind":"staff","discipline":"wood","description":"一级孢种升空，约一秒后青光击落；柔光草甸变色、透明能量破罩，浅咖色单藤缠敌并爆出尖刺，两次屏幕冲击随后收刺、回藤、碎散，落叶随草地消退。一、二阶共用疏草与至多四朵随机小白花。","flightVfxGuid":"5041847a-d803-533f-b994-c190af25b584","impactVfxGuid":"f3940500-ee2c-5379-8ca4-f509c3c41900","groundVfxGuid":"5044d0a5-c9c0-527b-9d84-8bf0d760a78a","distortionPipelineGuid":"37ad3ce1-8f32-506c-8c10-dafe94615bca","forms":[{"role":"root","minimumTier":2,"meshGuid":"8b8e1a93-c1fc-5390-9c7c-763e8c654f02","materialGuid":"ae5612c9-bf6b-5f76-b6cf-e8183c3f43c2","capacity":24},{"role":"leaf","minimumTier":2,"meshGuid":"1b67ee9d-c344-59dd-83b8-ca6315af9bc5","materialGuid":"9e7e844b-4c97-5b11-ac14-65bf30c0b39a","capacity":32},{"role":"seed-vine","minimumTier":1,"maximumTier":1,"meshGuid":"fc659865-8186-5599-aea1-c6ce328e12d3","materialGuid":"f86f0627-ade1-5297-bfba-6a597774e221","capacity":1},{"role":"seed-thorn","minimumTier":1,"maximumTier":1,"meshGuid":"5c0a3db8-aeeb-5fe5-ac32-72db8712ff1b","materialGuid":"f86f0627-ade1-5297-bfba-6a597774e221","capacity":8},{"role":"seed-meadow","minimumTier":1,"maximumTier":2,"meshGuid":"3a182029-dcda-5f92-ae0e-0d797877e2e7","materialGuid":"9e7e844b-4c97-5b11-ac14-65bf30c0b39a","capacity":29},{"role":"meadow-flower","minimumTier":1,"maximumTier":2,"meshGuid":"04354185-3975-5a44-914a-37260072b452","materialGuid":"93eea79b-0a3c-56c8-8c82-56c1068b4d08","capacity":4}],"element":"wood","school":"spell","coefficient":1,"flatDamage":12,"canCrit":true,"target":"hostile","count":1,"attackModule":{"moduleId":"elemental-cast","assetGuid":"d5291e57-daa2-57f5-8825-223c9e3851aa"},"effectRefs":[{"effectId":"effect.wood-spell.elemental-cast","assetGuid":"9355b51c-9368-542d-847e-a6cf431e5b52","programFingerprint":"effect-program/1:15212:e0e1d042cb59ceda"}],"affixPool":{"sourceEffectId":"effect.wood-spell.elemental-cast","version":1,"excludedReason":"青木术法选择木行缠根、移动施法与可选木性抗邪；未允许的词条不进入本器随机候选，草甸外观不会自行生成治疗、生命上限或飞剑资源。","rules":[{"effectId":"effect.affix.qi-efficiency","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"青木术法：孢种落击与木术弹体从主人施法池支付灵力，没有独立飞剑器气循环；植物意象与缠根不赋予本剑省耗消费者，养元仍只恢复主人灵力。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.turning-efficiency","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"青木术法：种子升落与木术弹体依元素施法轨迹运行，不读取连续飞剑的转弯半径；转锋不能让藤根追踪、延长束缚或变更施法走位。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.owner-qi-recovery","allowed":true,"weight":1,"reason":"青木术法：连续投下种子、孢子与根须需要主人灵力，养元补给下一次布置；植物并不产灵，该词也不增加抗性、主人回血或剑体修复。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.wood-flat","allowed":true,"weight":1.65,"reason":"青木术法：孢种落击与后续木术弹体均有木行直接命中，可补本器木行点伤。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.wood-increased","allowed":true,"weight":1.85,"reason":"青木术法：强化本器已有木行伤害，不延长缠根时长，也不令草甸产生治疗。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.spellpower","allowed":true,"weight":1.4,"reason":"青木术法：本器孢种和木术弹体按术法威力结算，明法有真实伤害消费者。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.spell-speed","allowed":true,"weight":1,"reason":"青木术法：缩短本器施法动作帧，保留一阶孢种先升空再落击的独立延迟。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.keen","allowed":true,"weight":0.5,"reason":"青木术法：木行直接命中允许暴击，缠根状态不会因此另作一次暴击。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.critical-force","allowed":true,"weight":0.4,"reason":"青木术法：低权重强化本器直接命中的暴击威力，保持缠根控场定位。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.cast-mobility","allowed":true,"weight":1.2,"reason":"青木术法：四阶可移动施法且都有40%至85%的动作移速惩罚，行法帮助边移动边布置缠根落区。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.cloud-step","allowed":true,"weight":1,"reason":"青木术法：提高主人的移动速度，便于绕行缠根敌人与重新选取落区，不改变孢种落击延迟。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.hit-recovery","allowed":true,"weight":0.85,"reason":"青木术法：主人受击中断后恢复身体动作，继续布置木术，不意味着提高藤蔓耐久。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.spirit-ward","allowed":true,"weight":0.45,"reason":"青木术法：可选木性抗邪分支：定灵新增主人的灵抗，减轻其受到的术法和诅咒伤害；原招的缠根与草甸并未自带这项抗性。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.metal-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"青木术法：本轮保持木行主攻，未选择额
